text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — I want to enable a small int4 precision profile (`q4_smoke`) as a smoke canary on hosted. Proposal: start at 5% traffic, only for internal beta/restricted orgs. Need eyes on guardrails and the rollback plan. Who can flip and monitor?
Samir Patel: +1 on testing but need concrete SLOs to auto-rollback. What's the metric set? latency, cost, quality thresholds? :eyes:
Maria Chen: Plan: monitor p95 latency (must not exceed baseline + 40ms), token-cost delta, and eval regression on our safety/factuality prompt set. Auto-rollback if: error rate spike > 0.5% OR factuality drop > 3 pts on 'smoke-evals-v3'. Also manual kill switch: `feature.quant.emergency_disable`.
Lena Ortiz: Who owns the rollout window? I can flip during my shift tomorrow at 11:30 PT. Will need the PR + the canary config applied to staging first.
Maria Chen: Thanks @Lena — I'll open the PR now. Config snippet for toggle (will include in the PR body):
```json
{
  "feature.quant.q4_smoke": {
    "enabled": false,
    "canary_pct": 0.05,
    "audience": ["internal-beta", "ml-team"],
    "rollback_conditions": {
      "error_rate_pct": 0.5,
      "factuality_drop_pts": 3,
      "p95_latency_ms_delta": 40
    }
  }
}
```
Samir Patel: Can we also add an automatic heatmap alert for token-level drift and a simple hypothesis test for generation quality? If the p-value < 0.01 for drop vs baseline, treat as signal.
Kevin O'Neill: Added a lightweight canary smoke test in CI that runs 50 prompts from `smoke-evals-v3` and compares BLEU/factuality heuristics. If <95% pass we fail canary job. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4923
Maria Chen: Nice, Kevin. Include runtime sampling (1-in-2000 requests) to record full outputs for human review. We'll redact sensitive fields before storing.
infra-bot: Canary cluster reservation created: `redwood-canary-02` (gpu-pool-small). Assigned owner: @infra-team.
deploy-bot: Canary config applied to `redwood-canary-02`. Env: staging -> canary. Triggered by PR 4923.
Lena Ortiz: I'll flip switch at 11:30 PT assuming PR passes and staging smoke is green. Who will monitor first 30 minutes?
Samir Patel: I'll watch quality dashboards and set up a temporary dashboard with these panels: p95 latency, error rate, token-cost delta, smoke-eval pass rate. Will add Slack alerts to #eng-oncall if thresholds hit.
Maria Chen: Add a short playbook in the PR with steps to rollback (flip `feature.quant.q4_smoke.enabled` false, then `feature.quant.emergency_disable` if issues persist), and who to page. Also add note: revert model-variant routing if required.
Kevin O'Neill: CI smoke tests added, and I pushed a small script to fetch sampled outputs to S3 for manual review: `scripts/canary/sample_outputs.sh`
Lena Ortiz: :thumbsup: I'll post a quick post-rollout note in #eng-ml with numbers. If anyone wants to join the monitor window ping me.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — goal is a safe, measurable smoke canary (no public traffic), and we keep rollback to a single flip. I'll merge PR after a quick review.
Samir Patel: One more ask: add a short regression prompt set for hallucination checks (5 prompts) that must stay within historical bounds. Otherwise auto-rollback.
Maria Chen: Will do. Thanks :rocket:
